summary: Review refactor: reuse existing capability and context helpers, remove redundant test assertions already covered by structural comparison, deduplicate repeated UI lookup code, and validate the website release ID once before its publish/rollback branch. Also let a future bundled-media seed retry after a failed iso-import, and remove two trailing blank lines from captured fixtures. Net code is reduced except for the focused retry regression.

guide.reason: Internal refactors plus a future-only bundled-media retry; current operator workflows, labels and recovery behavior are unchanged.

api.reason: No Controller/Core, agent, or client-facing operation, schema, authorization, retry, error or observed-result contract changes. The bundled-media retry fixes internal handling of the existing iso-import journal before a bundled ISO exists; public 0.2.9 intentionally seeds no virtio-win ISO.

roadmap.reason: No feature, milestone, or ordering change.

state.reason: The refactors add or alter no durable state. Existing Core journals, media files and Controller-owned records remain unchanged.

verification.method: Actual lane checks: go test -race -count=1 ./... passed (controller 137.699 s, vmhost 12.617 s; all packages passed, version has no tests); go test -race -count=1 ./internal/vmhost (including TestSeedBundledMediaRetriesFailedImport, 12.430 s); cd web && npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build; python3 -m py_compile on the staged integration targets; python3 -m unittest tests.test_fresh_install_gate_guest tests.test_fresh_install_host tests.test_fresh_install_recovery; bash -n tests/integration/controller_replacement_debian.sh; and python3 -m unittest tests.test_nex_website_publish tests.test_prune_iso_packages tests.test_release_publish tests.test_source_bundle tests.test_distribution_packaging tests.test_build_source tests.test_appliance_build tests.test_core_local_package tests.test_host_recovery tests.test_api_contract tests.test_storage_packaging (134 tests). Each reported passing in its lane. The focused failed-import test against the staged baseline, compiled through an isolated temporary Go overlay, failed exit 1 with 'failed import blocked bundled media seeding'; it passes after the fix. Browser verification was unavailable in the web lane, so no browser walkthrough is claimed. The original staged fixture additions still make git diff --cached --check report two trailing blank lines; this working-tree change removes them, but no index operation was performed. This assessment's own documentation and privacy checks are recorded separately in the review handoff.
